name: Velari
notes: Ancient, long-lived, bipedal humanoid species with adaptable physiology (survives harsh or terraformed environments); elongated form and high brain plasticity drove early technological dominance. Founders of the Velar Imperium (a technocratic monarchy of genetically engineered nobles and cyber-enhanced philosopher-kings). Cultural namesake of Vel-Surak. Primary polity: Velar Imperium.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Velari" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: Founding species of the Velar Imperium, but the Velari PEOPLE are not the Imperium STATE: Velari also live Union-aligned (e.g. the Velari-heritage world Vel-Surak sits in the Union) and drove the Republican Reformist movement. Imperial, reformist, and Union-aligned Velari all coexist.
cultural_note: "Velari" denotes the people and cultural heritage; "Velar Imperium" is one (fragmented) political expression of that heritage, not its whole. The Vel-Surak placement ruling (2026-07-21) turns on exactly this species≠state distinction.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.
